title: AI Trading Bot
author: Elfwood86
selftext:
Okay I am making hopefully my last AI bot. Call it script bot trading if you want. My other bots too too long because running a daily screening takes too much time. So I want a bot that will work on a 1 year time frame.

How does intial allocation work. Example $5000 starting.

The Bot will screen each stock to determine the Analyst price target + DCF + Graham Intrinsic value and divide that number by 3 to create a value.

The bot will allocate money to each holding with more money going to stocks that have a wider gap between the value and the share price.

Rule 1: Invest $100 monthly into only 1 stock will the greatest gap.

Rule 2: If a new company headquarted in a state surpasses the top company then replace the existing stock with the new stock.

Rule 3: Reset annually. Sell everything and start over at the begining. 

Running the bot once per month will save a lot of time and wont require complete analyst of all holdings which is time consuming. 

I will start trading on paper first.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Starting on paper and running it once a month is a sensible way to cut the work. Two things I'd check. Selling everything each year can add taxes and trading costs, so the result should be compared with simply buying an index fund and holding it. Analyst targets and DCF numbers also change over time, so a past test needs the values as they were on each date, not today's. One year at a time gives very few samples, so I'd run it across several different years. Cymetica's Backtest Labs lets you test a rule on stocks with a fee setting and a held out stretch of data.
